Edit a business rule

Usage: papyrus rule edit [OPTIONS] <ID>

Arguments:
  <ID>  

Options:
      --json
          Emit stable, machine-readable JSON.
      --title <TITLE>
          Update the title
  -d, --description <DESCRIPTION>
          Use "-" to read multiline text from standard input.
      --dir <path>
          Project directory. Default: the current working directory.
      --config <file>
          Configuration file. Default: papyrus.config.yml in the project directory.
      --requirement <REQUIREMENT>
          Add a business requirement. Repeatable
      --no-color
          Disable ANSI color output.
      --no-requirement [<NO_REQUIREMENT>]
          Remove a business requirement; without an ID removes all
      --editor
          Open the document body in $VISUAL or $EDITOR
      --label <LABEL>
          Label
      --reference <REFERENCE>
          Reference
  -h, --help
          Print help
